economic_rationale: KAMA changes its recursive smoothing rate with net displacement divided by total path movement, unlike a fixed SMA or EMA. The mechanism is useful only if the official-default KAMA30 state retains material upside after costs while reducing drawdown and improving Calmar with broad annual and adjacent 20/40-period support; adaptive smoothing alone is not alpha.
mechanism: For every complete UTC day, use exact TA-Lib KAMA with zero unstable period, fixed fast and slow constants from periods 2 and 30, and an efficiency-ratio window of 30 days for the primary. The strategy is fully long BTC when the completed-day close is strictly above KAMA and otherwise holds zero-yield cash, with state changes executed at the next H1 open. KAMA20 and KAMA40 are frozen rejection-only neighbors.
thesis: When a completed-day BTC close remains above a KAMA whose smoothing accelerates with directional path efficiency and slows with choppiness, the resulting causal next-open long/cash state may retain material efficient-trend upside while avoiding enough noisy or adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
title: Daily TA-Lib-default KAMA30 adaptive-trend long/cash timing
